subject: Install RHIPE on Mac OS X

messages.author: ddb2a2888088aa82
messages.subject: Install RHIPE on Mac OS X
parts:
Hello All,

N00b Disclaimer: I've never used R and could completely doing things wrong.

I'm following along in the quickstart and encountered a problem installing Rhipe. I have install R (3.1.0) via HomeBrew in my Mac 10.9 system. When I do the commands:

install.packages("devtools") # if not installed
library(devtools)
install_github("datadr", "tesseradata")
install_github("trelliscope", "tesseradata")

I eventually receive the following warning:

* DONE (trelliscope)
Warning message:
package ‘Rhipe’ is not available (for R version 3.1.0)

I am assuming this is harmless, but wanted to know for sure.

Thanks for your time!

-- Andy

messages.author: 2f3428d3166aad1c
messages.subject: Re: Install RHIPE on Mac OS X
parts:
Hi Andy,

Good call - trelliscope lists RHIPE as a "suggested" package, so R tries to install it when you install trelliscope.  RHIPE is not necessary unless using Hadoop as the back end.  The warning can be ignored.  We should make a note of that in the quick start.

We also should provide more detail for how to install RHIPE - R is looking on CRAN for the Rhipe package and can't find it - it needs to be installed from a separate location and it has other dependencies such as protobuf 2.4.1.

Ryan
